title: CameraDistance 2.8.1: bow zoom limit
intro: Reset Scripts NOW (the Camera Distance menu title must say 2.8.1). Then tick 'Limit the bow-aim zoom so player 2 stays in view', close the menu, press End.

steps.text: The main pawn close to your aim line: aim. Should look like the normal aim. Press End
The main pawn 5-10 m to one side, in front: aim. Does the camera ease back to keep him in? Press End
Keep aiming while he runs across and further out. Smooth? Does the arrow still go where you aim? Press End
The main pawn behind you: aim. Should be the normal aim plus the edge marker. Press End

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
probes.pscr: local p=H.pawn(0):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.ctrl: local mc=sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.CameraManager'):call('getMainCameraController',0); local c=mc:call('get_CurrentCameraController'); return c and (c:get_type_definition():get_name()..' '..tostring(c:call('get_BaseDistance'))) or 'nil'
